name: OneState
storyline:
In OneState, players enter a massive online city where every choice shapes their identity and future. Start from nothing and build your life through careers, business, crime, law enforcement, racing, and social interaction in a living multiplayer world filled with real players.

Rise through the ranks as a police officer, dominate the streets as a gang leader, become a successful entrepreneur, or create your own path in an ever-evolving sandbox experience. With dynamic events, player-driven economies, customizable vehicles, and large-scale roleplay systems, every story in OneState is created by the players themselves.
summary:
OneState is the first true mobile Social RolePlay. Every cop, boss, and street racer you meet is a real person. Explore an open world inspired by modern LA, where the American Dream comes alive on West Coast streets. With up to 900 real players per server, the city never stops evolving.

Start from nothing and choose your path: run a business, join a gang, wear the badge. Buy property, tune cars, make deals... and enemies.

New to RP? Just pick a role and make it yours. Join the biggest Social RolePlay community on mobile. Free to play on iOS and Android.
